content.text: The return of Euphoria season 3 shifts the focus back to Rue and the aftermath of the fractured relationships and consequences left from season 2, with the story picking up in a more time-jumped, character-restructured setting. Villa/GettyImages Date: Sunday, April 12, 2026 Time: 9:00 PM ET Channel: HBO Max Stream: HBO Max Bundle (watch now) The Tigers have taken control of the series behind improved pitching and a sudden offensive breakout, winning the first two matchups by a combined 15–6 margin. After entering the weekend with one of the league’s colder offenses, Detroit has flipped the script with timely power hitting and contributions throughout the lineup. Their pitching staff has also been sharp overall, holding opponents to just over three runs per game early in the season and keeping St. Louis from sustaining rallies outside of one big inning Saturday. – Live Stream Euphoria Season 3 – For the Cardinals, the challenge now is consistency. While the lineup has shown upside, highlighted by Walker’s explosive performance, the pitching staff has struggled to contain Detroit’s hitters, particularly in the middle innings. St. Louis entered the series with a winning record and slightly stronger early offensive metrics, but defensive lapses and pitching inefficiency have turned the tide.
